summary: Journey entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Journey
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release, with PS3 original as historical comparison

emulation.notes: Use native PC route for primary.

primary.why: Journey's PC release is the cleanest high-resolution capture route, while the PS3 original remains the historical launch version. The anonymous online companion system is central to the experience, so network/service state should be recorded.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC version through Steam/Epic. Record storefront/build, resolution, controller, online/offline state, companion encounters, and whether a PS3/PS4 run was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Historical launch version and original PSN context
secondary.what_to_play: Use only if preserving exact launch-era presentation.
secondary.why: PC is the stronger capture route, but PS3 is the original release artifact.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record online/offline state and companion encounters; experience differs if servers/matchmaking are unavailable.
